review.material: The official DRS2024 record was read, including its Conversation classification, six contributors, keywords and license. The PDF download returned HTTP 403.
review.limitations: The conversation text and any outcomes or examples it contains were not inspected. The record is not treated as a completed controlled robotics experiment.

sections.title: What is verified
sections.text: This contribution appears in the Conversations track of DRS2024. Its six listed contributors include Knight, and the publisher supplies embodied interfaces, robotics and computational making as keywords.

sections.title: What to look for
sections.text: The title invites a reading about how embodied interfaces are made and understood in robotic design. Check the original to learn its actual questions, proposed discussion format and examples; those details cannot be verified from the record alone.

sections.title: What cannot be claimed
sections.text: The full contribution was unavailable in this review. No robot design, participant study, performance result or collective conclusion has been invented. A conference conversation may have a different purpose from an empirical paper.

sections.title: Reading use
sections.text: Use the official source to follow the conversation and its cited projects. Distinguish proposals and participant perspectives from results supported by a documented experiment.
